create_vilt_config: create a ViltConfig instance with default transformer hyperparameters for ViLT model initialization
build_vilt_model_from_config: build a ViLT model using a ViltConfig instance to define architecture and hyperparameters
customize_vilt_hidden_size: customize the ViltConfig hidden_size parameter to set the transformer encoder dimension
configure_vilt_image_patches: configure ViltConfig image_size, patch_size, and max_image_length for vision transformer input
access_model_configuration: access the ViltConfig from an instantiated ViLT model via the model.config attribute
